lines.trans: Well, let's try your famous signature sauce.
This sauce is true high culinary art.
Oh, the fresh bread fell on the floor.
Right now we will quickly bring you new bread.
No, I am in a big hurry for an important meeting.
But you must taste this rare masterpiece!
I will return at exactly seven o'clock tonight.
We will prepare the very best sauce for you.
Agreed, Viktor, do not let me down tonight.
The Chef never deceives his favorite guests.
Until tonight then, I wish you great work.
We await you in the kitchen with great joy.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

meanings.note: + dative of person + genitive of thing: желаю вам удачи

examples.trans: Good health to you, sir! (I wish you health!)

meanings.note: Искусство войны = The Art of War

examples.trans: Read The Art of War, by Sun Tzu!
She loves modern art very much.

meanings.note: connected with cooking or the kitchen

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: come on, go on, let's see

meanings.note: usually in short form обязан/обязана + dative + instrumental

examples.trans: You are obliged to come on time.
I love our town very much.
I will never let you down.

examples.text: Надёжный друг никогда не подведёт в беде.
examples.trans: A reliable friend will never let you down in trouble.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: Он бы сейчас до потолка прыгал от радости.
examples.trans: He would be jumping to the ceiling for joy right now.
What a joy to see you!

meanings.note: to taste and understand the flavor

examples.text: Шеф ещё не распробовал новое блюдо.
examples.trans: The chef hasn't properly tasted the new dish yet.

examples.text: У меня есть много редких материалов.

meanings.note: ровно десять секунд = exactly ten seconds
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: Паста под соусом была очень вкусной.
examples.trans: The pasta with sauce was very tasty.
The chef prepared a spicy tomato sauce.

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?
We are in a big hurry for the train.
The cup fell off the table.

meanings.note: plural хлеба, stressed on the ending

examples.trans: The bread is on the table.

meanings.note: в два часа = at two o'clock

examples.trans: I'll be there in an hour.

час.governs: after 2, 3, 4 and полтора the genitive часа is stressed on the ending

meanings.note: outstanding work of art or skill

examples.trans: A masterpiece was made out of nothing.
This soup is a real masterpiece.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
